headline: Variance approved for a fire-required egress stair at 722 Center Street, with a 3.91 ft side setback.
summary: The stair would sit inside the side setback and must stay 10 ft from the main house. The Office of the State Fire Marshal and the town's fire marshal will still review the plans. Approvals also went to a second-floor addition at 53 Blakeslee Road and a 900 ft² garage at 1549 Tuttle Avenue. Application fees for the Tuttle Avenue garage request were waived in a 4-1 vote.
decisions: Approved a side yard variance of 3.91 ft for an egress stair at 722 Center Street, 5-0.
Approved a side yard variance of 9 ft for a second-floor addition at 53 Blakeslee Road, 5-0.
Approved a building coverage variance to build a 900 ft² garage at 1549 Tuttle Avenue, 5-0.
Approved a special exception for total garage area of 1,362 ft² at 1549 Tuttle Avenue, 5-0.
Approved waiving application fees for the 1549 Tuttle Avenue garage request, 4-1.
Approved the 2027 meeting schedule by voice vote.
discussion: Stair alternative to sprinklers: Members asked why a sprinkler system was not installed. The applicant said a system would cost around $80,000 and would disrupt tenants, so an independent egress was pursued.

State fire code: Members asked why two earlier modification requests were rejected. The applicant said the stair matches a fire code exception that allows an independent egress in place of sprinklers.
Second-floor addition: The application says the addition would not increase the side setback encroachment. It would match the existing roofline without raising the overall height.

Garage size and precedent: Members said the 900 ft² garage would be large next to the house, while the applicant said it fits the lot. Members also raised concern that approval could set a precedent for other lots.
Early return for a garage request: Members said another garage applicant could come back before April with a reduced plan, but not with the same application.
